name: terminal
description: Per-project terminal identity for iTerm2 — a Dynamic Profile that switches automatically when you enter the project directory, showing a wallpaper, an accent color shared by tab and cursor, and a translucent badge in the top-right corner that renders the live Claude Code session name. Ships the recipe as a skill, an idempotent installer that resolves machine-specific asset paths and degrades loudly instead of rendering a silently blank background, and a worked template. Command: /iterm-profile
